notes.note: Reviewed only the two-field tool.completed ingress ownership change against EventStore projection/persistence and existing snapshot consumers. Incoming htmlReply is removed alongside mcpAppResourceUri before persistence/replay handling; qualified Station render output still derives its bounded reference in snapshotEvent. MCP App catalog stamping and stored-stamp replay are unchanged. No migrations, SQL custody, room/revision ledgers, monitoring/config APIs, attachment authorization or other event fields change. This is a narrow source-delta review, not a re-audit of the documents or provider/native qualification.
